help.title: Ask Daoris
help.quick.title: Quick Ask
help.intro: What this machine lacks, each with the screen that fixes it and the command that does the same. Name an agent under AI features to talk with Ask Daoris as well.
help.introAgent: Ask below about Daoris on this machine: a screen, a refusal, how to drive a repository or start a task. Ask Daoris runs on {{agent}} and changes nothing itself. What this machine lacks comes first, each with the screen that fixes it and the command that does the same.
help.notFinished: This conversation could not be finished. Your draft is still here; try again.
help.proposal.title: Ask Daoris proposes
help.proposal.deleteNote: A delete removes the record from this machine, and a quest goes from every machine it reached once the delete syncs. It cannot be undone.
help.proposal.goNote: Going there changes nothing: what it is for is done on the screen itself.
help.proposal.titleGrant: Ask Daoris asks for a plugin's tools
help.proposal.titleWithdraw: Ask Daoris proposes taking a plugin's tools back
help.proposal.grant.shows: what Ask Daoris would be handed
help.proposal.grant.loses: what Ask Daoris would no longer be handed
help.proposal.grant.readsNone: reads with none of its tools
help.proposal.grant.writesAccepted: writes outside Daoris with {{tools}}, as you, accepted
help.proposal.grant.writesAsked: writes outside Daoris with {{tools}}, not accepted: Ask Daoris is refused it
help.proposal.plugin.runsNothing: runs no process of its own
help.proposal.plugin.copied: Apply copies its folder into Daoris's home under its id, as the folder stands now. Nothing it runs starts at the press: the driver starts it at its next look.
help.proposal.plugin.problem: As it stands it contributes nothing: {{problem}}
help.proposal.handNote: Apply gives the branch to the plugin, which pushes the branch to its remote, signed in as you, and opens the pull request. Daoris itself pushes nothing, and a plugin that does not push changes nothing.
help.proposal.plugin.replaced: Apply replaces its folder from where it came from, and what it kept stays. Nothing it runs starts at the press: the driver starts it again at its next look.
help.proposal.syncLook: Looking fetches each line from origin, as you, and moves only origin's own refs; the card then lists what the press would do. Nothing of yours moves until you apply, and Daoris never pushes.
help.proposal.syncNote: Apply does only the rows that move, each judged again right before it acts. Daoris fetches nothing more, and never pushes.
help.proposal.syncApart: {{names}}: not fetched, and nothing of theirs moves. A proposal naming one looks at it.
help.proposal.acceptNote: Accept is your yes to each departure above: what the quest holds goes on, and the departure stays on its record.
help.proposal.titleWorkflow: Ask Daoris proposes a workflow change
help.proposal.workflow.nothingLeaves: Nothing new leaves this machine without you.
help.proposal.workflow.needsNote: Apply is offered once each of these is met.
help.proposal.workflow.chooseLanded: It is chosen for the work that lands in {{scope}}.
help.proposal.workflow.chooseKind: It is chosen for {{scope}}'s kind of task {{kind}}.
help.proposal.workflow.versionKept: v{{version}} of {{name}}, as it is: no version is saved
help.proposal.workflow.verification: A verification pipeline: it checks the work that lands, and lands nothing itself.
help.proposal.workflow.lowersNote: Only your Apply makes this change.

help.introAgentFull: Ask below about Daoris on this machine: a screen, a refusal, how to drive a repository or start a task. Ask Daoris runs on {{agent}} with full access: it runs commands and edits files on this machine itself, without Apply. What this machine lacks comes first, each with the screen that fixes it and the command that does the same.
help.mode.title: Access
help.mode.confirm.label: Enable full access?
help.mode.confirm.says: Allow Ask Daoris to run commands, edit files and use every installed plugin server without Apply or routine permission approval? This choice is this machine’s: it affects future starts and supported continuations across workspaces.
help.mode.confirm.adds: It would also be handed these servers, which restricted mode withholds:
help.mode.confirm.addsNone: No plugin server is withheld from it now: full access adds running commands and editing files.
help.mode.confirm.addsReading: Reading which servers it would add…
help.mode.confirm.when: It takes effect at each conversation’s next turn: one running now ends as its turn ends, and your next words resume it with full access.

help.wired.failed: What it was handed could not be read
help.wired.notRecorded: Not recorded: this conversation started before Daoris kept what each start hands its agent.
help.wired.private: Kept on this machine only, as each start handed it: its paths are this machine’s.

help.grants.title: Configured access
help.grants.lead: In restricted mode, Ask Daoris also has what you choose here. Daoris holds each grant itself, never by widening the agent’s permissions, and a choice takes each conversation’s next turn.
help.grants.reach.housekeeping: Daoris’s own work: only the trees, branches and recovery material its cleanup judges permit. No command and no path.
help.grants.reach.browser: Daoris’s browser connection, signed-in pages included.
help.grants.reach.checkouts: The workspace’s checkouts, as far as each repository lets agents outside it read, through one read Daoris judges each time.
help.grants.reach.settings: Only the settings you choose, through the same checks and writer as Settings, each change recorded.
help.grants.reach.shell: Running commands, only inside an enforced file-system and process boundary around chosen Daoris trees, away from accounts and your home’s sensitive data.
help.grants.default.approval: By default it waits for your approval, as its plugin’s page asks.
help.grants.default.inherited: On by default, inherited: a repository’s choice first, then its workspace’s.
help.grants.pendingWhy: A conversation running now started with another choice: it ends as its turn ends, and its next turn takes this one. What it has shows what it was handed.
help.grants.why.changed: Its plugin’s update changed it since you approved it: Ask Daoris is handed nothing of it until you approve it again.
help.grants.why.browser: {{agent}} takes the browser’s server whole or not at all, so its approved reads and chosen writes are unavailable here until Daoris serves a mediated browser tool.
help.grants.why.shell: Only with an enforced boundary: a working folder, a `cd` or an instruction is not confinement.
help.grants.signedIn: Signed-in pages may be affected: it acts as you on the sites you are signed in to in Daoris’s browser.
help.grants.onPlugin: Its reads and writes are approved on its plugin’s page, the one place they are changed; Manage opens it.
help.grants.noPlugin: No plugin here offers Ask Daoris Daoris’s browser; Manage opens Plugins.
help.grants.op.housekeeping.inspect: Inspect what it may clean up
help.grants.op.housekeeping.discard-bran: Discard a session branch by name
help.grants.op.settings.notify: Announce what needs you or ended
help.grants.op.settings.timeout: How long one session may run
help.grants.op.settings.cap: Sessions at once on this machine
help.grants.op.settings.cooloff: Cool-off when no time is named
help.grants.never.housekeeping: Each target by its recorded identity and owner, judged again before it acts; a running or waiting session keeps its own branch, and nothing is forced.
help.grants.never.browser: Running code in a page is never granted.
help.grants.none.checkouts: No checkout here lets agents outside it read, so there is none to choose. A repository turns it on under its page → Setup → Reach.
help.grants.never.checkouts: A file’s text, a folder’s entries, `git status` and `git branch --list`, by a path inside the checkout; never what git ignores, git’s own folder, or `git log`, `diff` or `show`, whose output options can write files.
help.grants.never.settings: The access mode, these grants, accounts, plugin approval, reading across, standing answers, review, second opinions, helpers, commits, landing, driving and the safeguards stay out.
